text:
tom: Heads-up — FinServe POC hitting random stream cutoffs and 401s behind their corporate egress. Both TS and Python clients. They say it started after they rolled a new proxy cert.

jin: 401 during streaming? likely proxy doing TLS MITM and dropping Authorization header or swapping it. Any examples of response headers or auth flow?

tom: Customer pasted this from the TS console: 
  fetch error: Failed to fetch (network error)
  response headers snippet: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
  WWW-Authenticate: Proxy realm="Corp-SSO"

elaine: If the proxy intercepts and challenges, it can strip Authorization or inject a 401. Ask them to check proxy mode (transparent vs explicit) and whether Authorization header is being forwarded.

devon: On SDK side we can recommend sending a small preflight call (non-streaming) to validate auth header passthrough and identify if proxy rewrites it. Example curl to test: 
  curl -v --proxy http://corp-proxy:8080 -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx' https://api.redwood.example/v1/health 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p'

ops-bot: incident-template created: fs-poc-proxy-401-1732103333. Assigned to jin and devon.

jin: Also for streaming, some MITM proxies force HTTP/2 downgrade or rebuffer. Try forcing http1.1 on the client, enable keep-alive, and set small chunk flush (serverSentEvents style).

devon: For Python client try: 
  from requests import Session
  s = Session()
  s.headers.update({'Authorization': 'Bearer TOKEN', 'Connection': 'keep-alive'})
  r = s.post(url, stream=True, timeout=(3, 90))

and capture tcpdump on their egress to confirm if proxy removes header: 
  sudo tcpdump -nn -i eth0 host api.redwood.example and port 443 -w /tmp/poc.pcap

elaine: Security note for sales — FinServe's infosec is asking for our cert chain and whether we support mTLS to backend. Tom, they might require Private deployment if they refuse outbound TLS MITM. Flagging as blocker for quoting.

tom: I'll ask for proxy logs (request id they returned was xid-77b2) and confirm if the new cert is indeed installed cluster-wide. Also to try the curl test and the SDK keep-alive tweak. Syncing at 9am PT tomorrow to review logs.

jin: One more tip: enable SDK verbose logging (REDWOOD_LOG=debug) and have them paste the first 200 lines — often shows header mutation.

tom: Thanks — passing to FinServe and will update thread when we have logs. :pray:
